Counsel for the Respondent/complainant:
 Public Prosecutor
 2
 Dr.YLR,J
 Crl.P.No.13219 of 2025
 Dated 29.12.2025
The Court made the following:
Order:
The Criminal Petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (for brevity 'the Bnss') by the Petitioner/Accused No.7 for granting of pre-arrest bail in
connec

tion with C.C.No.113 of 2022 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Sathyavedu in Crime No.169 of 2020 of Sathyavedu Police Station, Chittoor District, registered for the alleged offence punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for brevity 'the IPC') and Section 7(1) of Essential Commodities Act.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the Petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
Perused the record.
3. As seen from the record, there are no adverse antecedents reported against the petitioner/Accused No.7.
The petitioner is a resident of Tamil Nadu State.
The allegation against him is that he acted as a broker for the transportation of PDS rice from Tamil Nadu to Andhra Pradesh.
An FIR was registered on 09.12.2020 in Crime No.169 of 2020.

After thorough investigation, a charge sheet was filed and the same was numbered as C.C.No.113 of 2022 on the file Between vs And on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64280581/
1 of the learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Satyavedu.
As the petitioner did not appear Dr.YLR,J Dated 29.12.2025 before the learned Magistrate, a Non-Bailable Warrant was issued against him.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the gravity and nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioner/Accused No.7, this Court is inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the petitioner/Accused No.7, with some stringent conditions.

5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed with the following conditions:
i.

In the event of his arrest, the petitioner/Accused No.7 shall be enlarged on bail subject to his executing a bond for a sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer, Sathyavedu Police Station, Chittoor District.

ii. The petitioner/Accused No.7 shall appear before the learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Sathyavedu, on each and every adjournment without fail and cooperate with the learned Trial Court for disposal of the case.
iii. The petitioner/Accused No.7 shall not cause any threat, inducement or promise to the prosecution Dr.YLR,J Dated 29.12.2025 witnesses.
iv. The petitioner/Accused No.7 shall not commit or indulge in similar offences in future.
v. The petitioner/Accused No.7 shall not leave the limits of the State of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu without the express permission from the learned Trial Court concerned.

__ __ Dr.Y. LAKSHMANA RAO, J.
